metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code with a deployable entry point (Dockerfile CMD node dist/server.js), a dependency manifest (package.json), IaC provisioning AWS resources (infra/ecs.yaml CloudFormation), and a single-service scope.
metadata.archetype_justification: Service owns persistent state in PostgreSQL (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE operations), exposes CRUD endpoints, and manages order entity lifecycle. Calls one downstream service (WarehouseClient) but does not coordinate 3+ services.

top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline definition exists in the repository
top_gaps.impact: Deployments are manual; no automated quality gates; triggers Move to Modern DevOps pathway

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.gap: No test files exist despite vitest being configured
top_gaps.impact: No automated verification of service behavior; regressions reach production undetected

top_gaps.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
top_gaps.gap: IaC covers only ECS cluster/task/service; RDS, ALB, networking, monitoring not defined
top_gaps.impact: Infrastructure drift risk; non-reproducible environments; triggers Move to Modern DevOps pathway

top_gaps.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
top_gaps.gap: Cross-service state changes (refund, cancel) executed synchronously with no messaging
top_gaps.impact: Tight coupling to WarehouseClient; cascading failure risk; no retry/idempotency mechanism

top_gaps.title: Encryption at Rest
top_gaps.gap: No explicit encryption-at-rest configuration in IaC
top_gaps.impact: Cannot verify data protection posture from repository evidence; compliance gap

findings.title: Managed Databases — Multi-AZ not confirmed
findings.description: PostgreSQL 15 on RDS (per README). Database credentials managed via Secrets Manager. However, the RDS instance is not defined in this repository's IaC, so Multi-AZ failover configuration cannot be confirmed.
findings.gap: Cannot verify Multi-AZ failover or automated failover configuration from repository evidence.
findings.recommendation: Include the RDS instance definition in this repository's IaC with MultiAZDeployment: true and automated failover enabled.

findings.title: Workflow Orchestration — No orchestration for multi-step operations
findings.description: Multi-step operations (refund: update DB then call payment processor; cancel: update DB then call warehouse) are sequential calls in OrderService with no orchestration, retry logic, or error handling between steps.
findings.gap: Multi-step operations lack orchestration primitives — no retries, no compensation on partial failure, no state tracking.
findings.recommendation: Consider Step Functions Express Workflows or a simple saga pattern with compensation logic for the refund and cancel flows.

findings.title: Async Messaging — No messaging for cross-service state changes
findings.description: No messaging infrastructure exists. Cross-service state changes (refund, cancel) are executed via synchronous calls. No SQS, SNS, EventBridge usage. For a stateful-crud service, this represents tight synchronous coupling.
findings.gap: State-changing operations affecting external systems use synchronous HTTP with no decoupling, retry mechanism, or failure isolation.
findings.recommendation: Introduce managed messaging (SQS or EventBridge) for refund and cancel operations. Publish domain events and process them asynchronously with idempotency keys.

findings.title: Network Security — No managed networking services
findings.description: ECS Service deployed in private subnets (AssignPublicIp: DISABLED). VPC and subnet IDs parameterized. No VPC endpoints, PrivateLink, or VPC Lattice configured.
findings.gap: No managed networking services layered on top. Security groups not explicitly defined in template.
findings.recommendation: Add VPC endpoints for ECR, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch Logs. Define explicit security groups with least-privilege rules.

findings.title: API Entry Point — ALB not defined in IaC
findings.description: CloudFormation description references ALB but no ALB resource is defined. No throttling, WAF, or request validation at the entry point. Auth is application-level only.
findings.gap: ALB not defined in IaC; no throttling, rate limiting, or WAF configuration at the entry point.
findings.recommendation: Define the ALB in IaC. Consider API Gateway for throttling and WAF integration, or configure ALB with WAF rules.

findings.title: Auto-Scaling — Static capacity only
findings.description: No auto-scaling configuration. ECS Service uses static DesiredCount: 2 with no scaling policies.
findings.gap: All capacity is statically provisioned. Cannot respond to traffic spikes or scale down during low demand.
findings.recommendation: Add Application Auto Scaling for ECS Service with target tracking on CPU utilization or request count.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery — No backup configuration
findings.description: No backup configuration found. RDS instance not defined in IaC, so backup settings cannot be verified. No AWS Backup plans.
findings.gap: Cannot verify automated backups for the PostgreSQL database. No documented restore procedures.
findings.recommendation: Include RDS in IaC with BackupRetentionPeriod (minimum 7 days), enable PITR, and document restore procedures.

findings.title: High Availability — Multi-AZ not explicit
findings.description: ECS Service DesiredCount: 2 with a list of subnets. Multi-AZ not explicitly confirmed. RDS HA configuration cannot be verified.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm multi-AZ deployment for compute or data. Fault isolation posture is not explicit.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly configure subnets across 2+ AZs. Include RDS with MultiAZDeployment: true.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage — Partial coverage (~40%)
findings.description: CloudFormation covers ECS Cluster, Task Definition, Service, IAM Role, Secrets Manager Secret. Missing: RDS, ALB, security groups, VPC, CloudWatch alarms, auto-scaling, backup plans.
findings.gap: Significant infrastructure managed outside version control. Environment reproduction requires manual steps.
findings.recommendation: Expand IaC to include RDS, ALB, security groups, CloudWatch alarms, auto-scaling, and backup plans. Target 90%+ coverage.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation — No pipeline exists
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline definition exists. No .github/workflows/, buildspec.yml, Jenkinsfile, or any pipeline configuration found.
findings.gap: All builds, tests, and deployments are manual. No automated quality gates.
findings.recommendation: Create a CI/CD pipeline with stages: lint, build, test, security scan, deploy to staging, integration test, deploy to production.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication — 100% synchronous
findings.description: All inter-service communication is synchronous HTTP. WarehouseClient called synchronously for refund and cancel. No message publishing or event-driven patterns.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. No decoupling, retry, or failure isolation for cross-service calls.
findings.recommendation: Introduce EventBridge or SQS for state-changing operations. Emit domain events on transitions; let downstream consumers process asynchronously.

findings.title: Long-Running Process Handling — All operations synchronous
findings.description: Refund and cancel operations involve variable-latency external calls handled synchronously. No status polling, callbacks, or async job processing. SAFETY.md documents timeout/retry risks.
findings.gap: All operations synchronous regardless of duration. External calls with variable latency have no async handling or timeout management.
findings.recommendation: Implement async job processing for refund/cancel: return 202 Accepted with job ID, process asynchronously, expose status polling endpoint.

findings.title: API Versioning — No versioning strategy
findings.description: No API versioning mechanism. Routes defined without version prefixes. OpenAPI info.version is documentation metadata only.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL path versioning (e.g., /v2/orders/:id). Register routes under a version prefix in Fastify.

findings.title: Service Discovery — Environment variables only
findings.description: Service endpoints configured via environment variables (JWKS_URI, JWT_ISSUER). No dynamic service discovery (Cloud Map, Consul, Istio).
findings.gap: Environment variables for endpoints but no dynamic discovery. Service relocation requires configuration changes.
findings.recommendation: Consider AWS Cloud Map for service discovery as the ecosystem grows.

findings.title: Unstructured Data Storage — No object storage
findings.description: No unstructured data storage capability. No S3 integration. All data in PostgreSQL as structured records. No infrastructure for order documents, receipts, or invoices.
findings.gap: No managed object storage for unstructured data. No capability to handle order-related documents.
findings.recommendation: If order-related documents are needed, add S3 integration with lifecycle policies. Consider Textract for document parsing.

findings.title: Unified Data Access Layer — Centralized but raw SQL
findings.description: All database access centralized in OrderService class. Single point of access for all operations. Uses raw SQL rather than a formal repository pattern.
findings.gap: Raw SQL queries in service class — database implementation details leak into domain service.
findings.recommendation: Extract a formal OrderRepository class encapsulating all SQL queries, providing a technology-agnostic data access interface.

findings.title: Database Engine Version — Not pinned in IaC
findings.description: PostgreSQL 15 documented in README. Not at EOL (November 2027). Version not pinned in IaC because RDS instance is not defined in this repository.
findings.gap: Version documented but not enforced in IaC. No documented version-update procedure.
findings.recommendation: Include RDS in IaC with explicit EngineVersion. Plan PostgreSQL 15 to 16 upgrade before EOL window.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest — No explicit configuration
findings.description: No explicit encryption-at-rest configuration in IaC. RDS not defined. Secrets Manager secret uses default AWS-managed key. No customer-managed KMS keys.
findings.gap: No customer-managed KMS keys. Encryption posture relies entirely on AWS service defaults.
findings.recommendation: Define customer-managed KMS key for database and Secrets Manager. Include explicit encryption configuration in RDS definition.

findings.title: Centralized Identity — IdP confirmed but SSO unverified
findings.description: Application integrates with centralized IdP via JWKS. JWT tokens verified against external public keys with issuer validation. SSO enablement cannot be confirmed from in-repo evidence.
findings.gap: Cannot confirm SSO or specific IdP platform from in-repo evidence.
findings.recommendation: Document the production IdP integration. Consider Cognito for native AWS integration if not already using it.

findings.title: Secrets Management — No rotation configured
findings.description: DB password in Secrets Manager with auto-generated value. Injected via ECS Secrets. No hardcoded credentials. JWKS_URI and JWT_ISSUER are non-secret config in env vars.
findings.gap: No automated rotation configured (no RotationLambdaARN or RotationRules). Secret remains static until manually rotated.
findings.recommendation: Add automated rotation with a Secrets Manager rotation Lambda. Configure 30-day rotation schedule.

findings.title: Compute Hardening — Default image, no scanning
findings.description: Dockerfile uses node:20-slim with non-root execution and multi-stage build. No vulnerability scanning, no hardened base image, no automated patching.
findings.gap: No vulnerability scanning on container images. No automated base image update strategy.
findings.recommendation: Add container image scanning (ECR or Snyk). Consider distroless image. Add Dependabot/Renovate for base image updates.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline — No security scanning
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No Dependabot/Renovate, no SAST, no container scanning. No CI/CD pipeline to integrate into.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools — vulnerabilities in dependencies or code reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add .github/dependabot.yml. Integrate npm audit and SAST (Semgrep) into CI/CD. Enable ECR image scanning.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing — Not instrumented
findings.description: No distributed tracing. No OpenTelemetry or X-Ray SDK in dependencies. No trace ID propagation. Structured logging with request IDs only.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing. Cannot debug failures across OrderService to WarehouseClient boundary.
findings.recommendation: Add OpenTelemetry SDK with X-Ray exporter. Auto-instrument Fastify, pg, and outbound HTTP.

findings.title: SLO Definitions — None defined
findings.description: No SLO definitions. No CloudWatch alarms. No latency or error-rate thresholds. Service logs to CloudWatch but has no monitoring thresholds.
findings.gap: No SLOs — no formal definition of acceptable service levels.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical operations: p99 latency for GET /orders, error rate for POST /orders, availability target.

findings.title: Business Metrics — None published
findings.description: No custom business metrics. No putMetricData calls. No metrics library. Only default ECS infrastructure metrics available.
findings.gap: No custom metrics — cannot measure business outcomes (order volume, refund rates).
findings.recommendation: Instrument business metrics via CloudWatch EMF: orders.created, orders.refunded, orders.cancelled. Create business KPI dashboard.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting — No alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms. No anomaly detection. No PagerDuty/OpsGenie integration.
findings.gap: No alerting — degradations discovered only through manual observation or customer reports.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for unhealthy tasks, p99 latency, 5xx rate. Enable anomaly detection. Integrate with alerting platform.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy — Circuit breaker but no canary
findings.description: ECS Service with DeploymentCircuitBreaker (Enable: true, Rollback: true). Automatic rollback on failed deployments. No canary/traffic shifting.
findings.gap: No canary deployment. Circuit breaker catches catastrophic failures but not subtle regressions.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to CodeDeploy blue/green with traffic shifting (10% → 50% → 100%) and CloudWatch alarm rollback triggers.

findings.title: Integration Testing — No tests exist
findings.description: No test files exist. vitest configured as devDependency with test script, but no actual test files (*.test.ts, *.spec.ts) present.
findings.gap: No automated tests at all. Regressions in order CRUD, refund, or cancel flows reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Create integration tests using vitest covering order creation, retrieval, refund, cancel, and auth. Use testcontainers for PostgreSQL.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation — No runbooks
findings.description: No runbooks, no SSM Automation documents, no self-healing patterns. Incident response is entirely ad hoc.
findings.gap: No runbooks — no automated remediation for common failures.
findings.recommendation: Create structured runbooks for: database connectivity loss, WarehouseClient timeouts, ECS task failures. Consider Lambda-based self-healing.

findings.title: Observability Ownership — Not defined
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS file. No per-service dashboards. No alarms with named owners. No SLO definitions with team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability ownership — no defined responsibility for monitoring or alerting.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS. Create CloudWatch dashboard. Define alarms with notification targets. Tag resources with team ownership.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance — No tags
findings.description: No tags on any resource in CloudFormation template. ECS Cluster, Task Definition, Service, IAM Role, and Secrets Manager Secret all lack Tags.
findings.gap: No tags found. Cannot track costs, identify ownership, or enforce budget controls.
findings.recommendation: Add consistent tags to all resources: Service, Team, Environment, CostCenter.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — all compute on ECS Fargate (fully managed). No EC2.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — Node.js 20, TypeScript 5.4, Fastify 4.26. Modern language, framework, and runtime.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — single independently deployable microservice with clear boundaries and own database.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — no stored procedures or proprietary SQL. All business logic in application layer.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Audit logging (CloudTrail) is an account-level concern. This repo contains application-level IaC only (ECS, IAM, Secrets Manager). CloudTrail evaluation belongs in the foundation infrastructure repo.

evaluations.title: API Authentication
evaluations.reason: Score 4 — all endpoints use JWT bearer token auth (RS256) with JWKS, issuer, audience validation, and role enforcement.
